title: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
summary: Kai particles ya rigid body ki translation ko ek point — centre of mass (COM) — se samjhte hain: poora external force COM par laga maan lo, Ma_cm = F_ext. Internal forces COM ki motion nahi badalte.

Rotation mein har linear cheez ka ek jodidaar hai: displacement → θ, velocity → ω, acceleration → α, mass → moment of inertia I, force → torque τ, momentum → angular momentum L. Formula bhi same shape ke: τ = Iα, L = Iω, KE = ½Iω².

Moment of inertia mass ke saath-saath mass ke axis se door hone par depend karta hai (I = Σmr²). Standard bodies ke I ratta maaro; doosre axis ke liye parallel axis (I = I_cm + Md²) aur perpendicular axis (I_z = I_x + I_y, sirf planar body) theorem.

External torque zero ho to angular momentum conserve hota hai (Iω constant) — skater haath sikodta hai to tez ghoomta hai. Rolling without slipping mein v = ωR, aur KE = ½mv²(1 + k²/R²); incline par jiska k²/R² kam woh pehle neeche pahunchta hai.

formulas.name: Centre of mass
formulas.formula: x_cm = Σmᵢxᵢ / Σmᵢ;   continuous: x_cm = ∫x dm / ∫dm;   r_cm = Σmᵢrᵢ / M
formulas.note: COM body ke bahar bhi ho sakta hai (ring, L-shape).

formulas.name: Standard centres of mass
formulas.formula: semicircular ring 2R/π;  semicircular disc 4R/3π;  solid hemisphere 3R/8;  hollow hemisphere R/2;  solid cone h/4 (base se)
formulas.note: Saari doori flat side / centre se naapi gayi hain.

formulas.name: Motion of centre of mass
formulas.formula: M v_cm = Σ mᵢvᵢ (total momentum);   M a_cm = F_ext;   F_ext = 0 ⇒ v_cm constant
formulas.note: Explosion ke baad bhi COM wahi parabola follow karta hai.

formulas.name: Rotational kinematics
formulas.formula: ω = ω₀ + αt;   θ = ω₀t + ½αt²;   ω² = ω₀² + 2αθ;   v = ωr, a_t = αr
formulas.note: θ radian mein; rev ko 2π se multiply karo.

formulas.name: Torque
formulas.formula: τ = r × F;   |τ| = rF sinθ = F × (perpendicular distance)
formulas.mistake: Axis se guzarne wala force torque nahi deta.

formulas.name: Newton's second law for rotation
formulas.note: I usi axis ke baare mein lo jiske baare mein τ liya.

formulas.name: Angular momentum
formulas.formula: L = r × p;   rigid body: L = Iω;   τ = dL/dt
formulas.note: Seedhi line mein chalti particle ka bhi kisi point ke baare mein L hota hai (= mvr⊥).

formulas.name: Conservation of angular momentum
formulas.mistake: L conserve hota hai, rotational KE nahi (haath sikodne par KE badhti hai).

formulas.name: Moment of inertia and radius of gyration
formulas.formula: I = Σmr² = ∫r² dm;   I = Mk²  (k = radius of gyration)
formulas.note: I axis par depend karta hai — 'disc ka I' tab tak adhoora jab tak axis na bataya ho.

formulas.name: Standard moments of inertia
formulas.formula: ring (centre ⊥) MR²;  disc ½MR²;  hollow sphere ⅔MR²;  solid sphere ⅖MR²;  rod (centre ⊥) ML²/12;  rod (end) ML²/3;  ring (diameter) ½MR²;  disc (diameter) ¼MR²;  solid cylinder (axis) ½MR²

formulas.name: Parallel axis theorem
formulas.when: COM se d door parallel axis.
formulas.mistake: Sirf COM wale axis se shuru karo, kisi aur se nahi.

formulas.name: Rotational KE, work and power
formulas.formula: K = ½Iω²;   W = ∫τ dθ;   P = τω
formulas.mistake: W = τθ sirf constant torque par.

formulas.name: Rolling without slipping
formulas.formula: v_cm = ωR;   K = ½mv²(1 + k²/R²);   incline: a = g sinθ/(1 + k²/R²);   v = √[2gh/(1 + k²/R²)]
formulas.when: Ball, cylinder, ring ludhak rahe hain.
formulas.mistake: Rolling mein contact point ki velocity zero; friction kaam nahi karta (energy conserve).

formulas.name: Which rolls down first
formulas.formula: k²/R²: solid sphere 2/5 < disc/solid cylinder 1/2 < hollow sphere 2/3 < ring 1 ⇒ solid sphere pehle, ring aakhir mein
formulas.mistake: Mass aur radius se farak nahi padta — sirf shape (k²/R²).

formulas.name: Equilibrium of a rigid body
formulas.formula: ΣF = 0 (translational) aur Στ = 0 kisi bhi point ke baare mein (rotational);   couple: net force 0, torque F × d
formulas.note: Torque ka point aisa chuno jahan unknown forces lag rahe hon — equations chhoti ho jaati hain.

examples.title: Do particles ka COM
examples.problem: 2 kg x = 0 par aur 3 kg x = 5 m par. COM?
examples.solution: x_cm = (0 + 15)/5 = 3 m — bhaari mass ki taraf.

examples.title: Disc: centre aur rim
examples.problem: 2 kg, R = 0.5 m disc. Centre ke perpendicular axis aur rim par parallel axis ke baare mein I?
examples.solution: I_cm = ½MR² = 0.25 kg·m². Rim par: I = I_cm + MR² = 0.75 kg·m² (= 3/2 MR²).

examples.title: Rod ke end par I
examples.problem: 3 kg, 2 m rod, ek end se perpendicular axis. I?

examples.title: Torque
examples.problem: Spanner par 10 N force 0.5 m door, spanner se 30° angle par. Torque?

examples.title: Skater
examples.problem: Skater I = 4 kg·m², ω = 3 rad/s. Haath sikodkar I = 2 kg·m². Naya ω aur KE?
examples.solution: I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂ ⇒ ω₂ = 12/2 = 6 rad/s. KE: 18 J se 36 J — badhi (muscles ne kaam kiya).

examples.title: Incline par solid sphere
examples.problem: Solid sphere 30° incline par bina slip ludhakta hai, height 7 m (g = 10). Acceleration aur neeche speed?

examples.title: Rolling disc ki KE
examples.problem: 2 kg disc 4 m/s se roll kar rahi hai. Total KE?
examples.solution: K = ½mv²(1 + ½) = ½ × 2 × 16 × 1.5 = 24 J (iska 1/3 rotational).

examples.title: Flywheel
examples.problem: Flywheel rest se α = 2 rad/s² se 5 s ghoomta hai. ω aur θ?
examples.solution: ω = αt = 10 rad/s. θ = ½αt² = 25 rad.

examples.title: Radius of gyration
examples.problem: 1 m radius ring ka diameter ke baare mein k?
examples.solution: I = ½MR² = Mk² ⇒ k = R/√2 ≈ 0.71 m.

examples.title: Motor ki power
examples.problem: Motor 20 N·m torque se 50 rad/s par ghumaata hai. Power?

examples.title: Seesaw
examples.problem: 30 kg bachcha pivot se 2 m door. 40 kg bachcha kahan baithe ki balance ho?

topics.title: Rigid body aur motion ke prakaar
topics.explain: Rigid body mein particles ki doori nahi badalti. Motion: pure translation (sab points same velocity), pure rotation (fixed axis ke chaaron taraf), ya dono (rolling).

topics.title: Centre of mass vs centre of gravity
topics.explain: COM mass distribution se tay hota hai; uniform g mein centre of gravity wahi point. Symmetric uniform body ka COM geometric centre par. COM par lagaaya force sirf translation deta hai.

topics.title: Torque aur angular momentum ka matlab
topics.explain: Torque ghumaane ki koshish hai — darwaze ka handle hinge se door isliye lagta hai. Angular momentum ghoomne ka 'momentum' hai. Particle ka L = mvr⊥ kisi bhi point ke baare mein.

topics.title: Moment of inertia kis par depend
topics.explain: Mass, mass ka distribution aur axis ki position. Same mass ki ring ka I disc se zyada (saara mass rim par). Flywheel ka zyada mass rim par rakhte hain taaki rotation smooth rahe.

topics.title: Linear vs rotational analogy
topics.explain: x ↔ θ, v ↔ ω, a ↔ α, m ↔ I, F ↔ τ, p ↔ L, F = ma ↔ τ = Iα, KE ½mv² ↔ ½Iω², P = Fv ↔ τω. Ek yaad to doosra apne aap.

topics.title: Rolling motion
topics.explain: Rolling = translation + rotation. Top point ki speed 2v, contact point zero. Static friction rolling banaata hai par kaam nahi karta. Smooth incline par body sirf slide karegi, roll nahi.

topics.title: Conservation of angular momentum ke examples
topics.explain: Skater/dancer haath sikodta hai — I ghata, ω badha. Diver hawa mein body mod kar zyada somersault karta hai. Ghoomte stool par aadmi dumbbells andar kheenchta hai. Planets suraj ke paas tez chalte hain (Kepler ka doosra niyam).

ratta: Ma_cm = F_ext;  internal forces COM nahi hilaate.
τ = Iα;  L = Iω;  K = ½Iω²;  P = τω.
Ring MR², disc ½MR², solid sphere ⅖MR², hollow sphere ⅔MR², rod ML²/12 (centre), ML²/3 (end).
I = I_cm + Md²;  I_z = I_x + I_y (planar).
Rolling: v = ωR;  a = g sinθ/(1 + k²/R²).
Race: solid sphere > disc > hollow sphere > ring.
COM: semicircular ring 2R/π, disc 4R/3π, solid hemisphere 3R/8.
